Title: Digital capability and innovation performance
Authors: Chen Li; Wang Min

Research question
This study asks whether digital capability improves product innovation in manufacturing firms.

Data and method
The sample contains 428 manufacturing firms observed from 2018 to 2022. We estimate a fixed-effects panel model. Digital capability is the independent variable and product innovation is the dependent variable.

Findings
Digital capability is positively associated with product innovation. The association remains after replacing the innovation measure and excluding the 2020 observations.

Limitations
The single-country sample limits external validity. The paper does not report a randomized design.
